senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of salsamentum) salted food, preserve. Sifra B’har, Par. 3, ch. IV (ref. to Lev. XXV, 22) ישן לא מלמטן (corr. acc., or סלסמן salsamen) ‘old produces’ (in natural condition,) not preserved; Yalk. Lev. 661 ולא סלמינטין (read: סַלְמִינְטוֹן); B. Bath. 91ᵇ בלא ס׳ without need of preserving; v. רְצִינְתָּא.
